## Download

Pick one file.

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 | [${WIN}](https://github.com/dillon-shearer/Kanban95/releases/download/v${VERSION}/${WIN}) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 and later) | [${MAC_ARM}](https://github.com/dillon-shearer/Kanban95/releases/download/v${VERSION}/${MAC_ARM}) |
| Mac with Intel | [${MAC_INTEL}](https://github.com/dillon-shearer/Kanban95/releases/download/v${VERSION}/${MAC_INTEL}) |

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu -> About This Mac shows the chip.

"Source code" is not the app. Only download it if you want to build Kanban95 yourself.

## Install

**Windows**
1. Run the setup.exe. It needs no admin rights.
2. If SmartScreen warns you, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The app is not signed.

**Mac**
1. Open the .dmg and drag Kanban95 to Applications.
2. The first time, Control-click Kanban95 in Applications, choose **Open**, then **Open** again. The app is not signed.
3. If there is no Open button, go to System Settings -> Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**.

## You also need

- [git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)
- [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) or [Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex), installed and logged in

The app brings its own Node. On first start it asks for a data folder and a project.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dillon-shearer/Kanban95/compare/${PREV}...v${VERSION}
